responsibilities: The role exists to lead the development and enhancement of our modern data transformation platform, ensuring data is reliable, scalable and ready for future growth.
You'll coordinate engineering delivery, support and develop a talented team, and help drive our move from legacy platforms to a cloud-based data ecosystem.
Working with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders, you'll make sure our data products meet business needs and deliver real value.
You'll also play an important role in shaping engineering standards, ways of working and continuous improvement across the team.
